This screen covers error cases which are triggered/resolved by dependencies.

If the value of the master field is:

  • "Trigger errors on this screen": An error for the master field and the three dependent fields below on this screen should be triggered.
  • "Solve errors on this screen": All errors for the master field and the three dependent fields below on this screen should be resolved.
  • "Trigger errors on this screen and on Other Screen": An error for the master field and the three dependent fields below on this screen should be triggered. The three corresponding dependent fields on Other Screen should change as well, but have no errors.
  • "Solve errors on this screen and on Other Screen": All errors for the master field and the three dependent fields below on this screen should be resolved. The three corresponding dependent fields on Other Screen should change as well. Existing errors on those fields should be resolved.
  • "Trigger errors on Other Screen": The three corresponding dependent fields on Other Screen should change, but have no errors.
  • "Solve errors on Other Screen": The three corresponding dependent fields on Other Screen should change. Existing errors on those fields should be resolved.

The master enumerations for both dependent values are computed from changes to the attachment / multi-select.

For the attachment changes, upload files with the following names:

  • "trigger.jpg": An error for the field below on this screen should be triggered.
  • "resolve.jpg": The error for the field below on this screen should be resolved.
  • "triggerBoth.jpg": An error for the field below on this screen should be triggered. The corresponding field on Other Screen should change as well, but have no errors.
  • "resolveBoth.jpg": The error for the field below on this screen should be resolved. The corresponding field on Other Screen should change as well and an existing error should be resolved.
  • "triggerOther.jpg": The corresponding field on Other Screen should change, but have no errors.
  • "resolveOther.jpg": The corresponding field on Other Screen should change and an existing error should be resolved.
Controls in this screen are dependent on the master value in the Error Messages screen.
Triggered by computation on the "Error Messages" screen

This screen covers the setting of values/erros in a dependency chain.

Master Field 1 will set the value of Master Field 2

Master Field 2 will set the value of the dependent fields. It should always set one correct and one incorrect value.
There should never be more than one error for the dependent fields!

This screen shows how parsing error messages are cleared, when the dependent element is set to not relevant or to a valid value.


Enter values into the inputs which produce parsing errors, e.g. strings everywhere.

Switch the master enum to 'set fields value'.

The entered values and messages of the first grid should be set to valid or no values, except for the date field.

The error message of number2 should be cleared and the field set to a valid value.

The computed fields should have updated afterwards.


Switch the master enum to 'dependent group not relevant'.

The first two grids should disappear. The error messages that refer to its fields should be removed as well (check via redux dev tool).
